note: Evals cover the mechanical shell only. The verdict is subjective and stays with the auditor (CRE's seat); no assertion grades it.

evals.name: read-only-skill-pass-path
evals.prompt: test skill link-audit. Goal met if: the report lists every dangling wikilink in the vault, none are false positives, and nothing is edited. Test case: the live vault as-is.
evals.expected_output: One report at SYSTEM/reports/DATE-skill-test-link-audit.md, verdict first, all nine sections present, three RUN summaries, stand-in rulings table, drift line, Not checked. No _BACKLOG item unless the verdict is short of PASS.
assertions: First content line of the report is the VERDICT: line with one of PASS, PASS-WITH-NOTES, FAIL
All nine required section headings are present in order
Three RUN headings (RUN 1, RUN 2, RUN 3) are present with a path each
Stand-in rulings table is present (may be the 'none reached' row)
skill_test_shell.py check exits 0 on the finished report
No file under WRITING/, REFERENCE/, or the OS anchors was modified

evals.name: writer-skill-runs-in-fixture
evals.prompt: run the skill test on chapter-init. Goal met if it scaffolds CHAPTER 99 - TEST with every convention file and correct chapter frontmatter. Test case: Witchwood, chapter 99, title TEST.
evals.expected_output: The skill is classed as a writer; every run writes only under SYSTEM/skill-tests/chapter-init/DATE/run-K/ (a fixture copy of the project skeleton), never into WRITING/PROJECTS/WITCHWOOD. Report present, verdict first.
assertions: Report's Write class line says 'writes' and names a fixture path under SYSTEM/skill-tests/chapter-init/
A CHAPTER 99 folder exists under each run-K directory and NOT under WRITING/PROJECTS/WITCHWOOD/CHAPTERS/
skill_test_shell.py check exits 0 on the finished report
Report Not checked section is non-empty

evals.name: fail-verdict-writes-handoff-and-backlog
evals.prompt: test the skill dictation-preflight. Goal met if envelope.md is filled with POV, conditions, and state per segment from the queued dictation. Test case: the fixture chapter in SYSTEM/skill-tests/_fixtures/ch-preflight-broken (its dictation folder is empty, so the skill should trip its empty-input gate).
evals.expected_output: Runs hit the gate; each logs a stand-in ruling; auditor rules FAIL or PASS-WITH-NOTES; the report carries a skill-creator handoff block of substance and one _BACKLOG item exists at the top of ## OS / Meta with anchor ^backlog-skilltest-dictation-preflight-DATE.
assertions: skill-creator handoff section is non-empty and does not start with 'None'
Handoff block names the skill, the installed path, the goal, evidence paths, the change wanted, and what must be true after
_BACKLOG.md contains the anchor ^backlog-skilltest-dictation-preflight-<date> under ## OS / Meta
Every stand-in ruling logged in audit/stand-in-rulings.md appears in the report table, and each gate has exactly one ruling applied to all three runs
skill_test_shell.py check exits 0 on the finished report
The installed dictation-preflight SKILL.md was not modified
